clips.name: pickplace
clips.title: pickplace
clips.recipe_note: site: rerun_clips.py rerun route (headless Rerun, lerobot_rerun_viz.py), viz config from build_mv_site.config_for openarm branch (build_mv_site.py:138-146): the rig is read off the dataset's left_gripper_model: `openarm` -> mv_site/configs/openarm_lerobot.json (wrists Arducam IMX708 hfov 99.1, head Supertek OV2710 hfov 66.4, from the export bundle), `openarm umi` -> openarm_yuto.json (UMI soft fingers). The yuto rule names registry:openarm umi explicitly: profile auto would reach the generic UMI GoPro kind through the `umi` substring match before the registry lookup. Site tiles are LEFT-first (mp4 tile order of the 2026-10-03 Rerun renders): pick_and_place ep11 and pick_and_place_clean ep11 (2-view bi_openarm, lerobot config) left, right; pickplace ep6 (yuto) left, right, head; the rules list head last so the 3-view lerobot rigs keep their head tile (the renderer skips streams the dataset lacks). full_folding ep7 and high_quality_folding ep9 were reused from the 2026-09-16 curation-browser Rerun renders, whose older order was right, left, head. Single-arm community uploads (right wrist only) had no config in config_for and fall back to the project config. overlay_picks.py:276 used config/openarm.json for the two folding datasets (older). Per-episode intrinsics (meta/episodes intrinsics_fx_fy_cx_cy) exist for every openarm dataset and drive both tools; the config FOVs are only the fallback
caveats: The previous website shows episode 6; the public sample contains episode 0.
